The FloPlast 92.5° double socket branch is a crucial component for efficient soil and vent drainage systems. Manufactured from durable uPVC, this grey 110mm push-fit branch offers strength and is lightweight for straightforward installation in various properties. Its design allows for the seamless connection of both 32 and 40mm waste pipes to a 110mm soil stack, making it an ideal choice for connecting multiple waste points such as basins and toilets within any plumbing setup. The secure push-fit connection, featuring reliable ring seals, ensures a leak-free joint and can withstand high temperature waste discharges. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
